name: Icelord Kvasir

facts.text: Kvasir is a level-80 icelord with 100,000 health; two hrimthursa icetouch come with him.
He lets loose a primal scream that resonates in the ice and stuns those near him; he also mesmerizes in a wide ring and roots.
When he dies a low rumble runs through the glacier, icicles fall and it sounds as though a swarm of giants is on the move.
In the original, cold damage healed him; the Offline DAoC build turns that off for bot raids.
In Norse myth Kvasir is the wisest of beings, whose blood was brewed into the mead of poetry.
facts.source: Snorri, Skaldskaparmal (public-domain myth); used as inspiration

story: The icelords give their sons names from the old songs, and Kvasir's father chose the wisest name of all. It did not take. Kvasir is the glacier's alarm: when he fights, he screams, a sound so raw it rings in the walls and drops men where they stand, and when he dies the ice itself carries the news. A rumble runs down every tunnel, icicles shatter on the floors, and somewhere deeper the hrimthursa take up arms and move. The council called him a brute. The icelords call him a horn: you do not need a horn to be wise, only loud.
legend: Kvasir mezzes and stuns in a big ring, so bring cure-mez and stagger your melee. When he goes down, get ready: the whole glacier hears it, and the giants come. The old raiders said frost healed him; the new raiders just hit him harder.

aggro: Do you not wish you had chosen a safer road today?

phases.text: HRAAAAH! Hear me, every hall of the ice!

slay: You came so far to die so loudly.

lairEntry: Old scream-marks craze the ice of this tunnel.

phases.text: A rumble runs through the glacier. Giants are moving!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Icelord Kvasir is silenced. The glacier shudders.

briefing: kvasir screams and stuns everyone near him, melee [stagger in|go in waves]
when kvasir dies the glacier wakes up, [be ready|regroup fast]
aftermathWin: kvasir down. hear that rumble? here they come
aftermathLoss: kvasir's mez caught both healer groups. [rip|gg]
rumour: the old songs had a wise man called kvasir. the icelord is not that

loremasterTopic.text: Named for the wisest being of the old songs, and wise in nothing. He is the glacier's horn: he screams and men fall, and when he dies the ice carries the news to every hall. Expect company.
